name: place_order
description: Submit an order to IBKR. Confirm-gated: a first call (no `confirm`) returns a preview {contract, order, notional}. A second call with `confirm: true` actually sends, and additionally requires the MCP server to be started with `:allow-orders? true`. Supports single-instrument MKT/LMT orders and multi-leg combos (sec_type: "BAG" with combo_legs).

symbol.description: Ticker symbol. Required unless sec_type is "BAG".

quantity.description: Number of shares (STK), contracts (OPT), or spreads (BAG).

order_type.description: Order type. STP / STP LMT not yet supported.

limit_price.description: Limit price (required when order_type is LMT).

outside_rth.description: Allow execution outside regular trading hours. Default false.

combo_legs.description: Multi-leg structure for sec_type BAG. Each leg: {conid, ratio, action (BUY/SELL), exchange}.

confirm.description: Must be true on the second call to actually send the order. Default false (preview).
